questions.question: Four number-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one Is different. Select the one that Is different.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**1st number is the square of 2nd number.**

By checking options:

(1) 225 : 15 → 15² = 225

(2) 289 : 17 → 17² = 289

(3) 484 : 22 → 22² = 484

**(4) 322 : 18 → 18² = 324 ≠ 322**

Hence, **322 : 18 **is the odd one.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given letter series will complete the series.

ZH_ORC_ _K_R_ZH_O_C

options.text: K, Z, H, K, R, K, R
Z, H, K, O, C, K, R
K, Z, H, O, C, K, R
K, Z, O, R, C, K, R

questions.solution:
Given: ZH_ORC_ _K_R_ZH_O_C

By checking options:

(1) K, Z, H, K, R, K, R → ZH**K**ORC / **ZH**K**K**R**R / **ZH**K**O**R**C

(2) Z, H, K, O, C, K, R → ZH**Z**ORC / **HK**K**O**R**C / **ZH**K**O**R**C

**(3) K, Z, H, O, C, K, R →** ZH**K**ORC / **ZH**K**O**R**C / **ZH**K**O**R**C

*(here, ZHKORC is repeating)*

(4) K, Z, O, R, C, K, R → ZH**K**ORC / **ZO**K**R**R**C / **ZH**K**O**R**C

Option (3) gives a pattern of ZHKORC / ZHKORC / ZHKORC.

Hence, **K, Z, H, O, C, K, R **is the correct answer.
